The '''''Whaladon''-class container ship''' was a class of large [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that saw use during the years prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Slow and costly, they were used for transporting cargo between systems. They could not land, therefore smaller transports took deliveries to collect and transfer their stock. One such ship was ''[[Shandy's Pleasure Palace]]'', which was utilized as a type of portable [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].
